howto: Pick a game card on the menu and press PLAY.
The first time you open each game a card shows its controls; press Let's play.
Bridge Race, Tetris, Snake, Breakout, Flappy and the Space Shooter end when you fall, top out or lose your lives; Chess ends on checkmate.
Your best score in every game is listed under the cards on the menu.
tips: Neon Tetris: clearing four rows at once scores 800 times the level.
Neon Snake: plan a loop around the walls before your tail gets long.
Bridge Race: stay on the ground to pick up planks; jumping skips them.
Neon Breakout: hit the ball with the edge of the paddle to steer it.
Hyper Chess: the legal moves light up when you click a piece.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD in every game, Space to jump, flap or fire; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: The on-screen arrow and action buttons under each game, or tap and drag on the canvas; the pause button sits top right

difficulty: Each game ramps on its own: Tetris gets faster every 10 lines, Snake speeds up as it grows, Bridge Race speeds up after 200 m, Breakout and the Space Shooter give three lives.

cheats.effect: Neon Tetris: the bottom four rows vanish

features.difficulty: Per-game ramps: Tetris levels speed up the fall, Snake speeds up as it grows, Bridge Race speeds up after 200 m
features.wave-or-level-counter: Neon Tetris shows Level and Lines; Bridge Race shows distance to the flag; Breakout and the Shooter show lives
features.high-score-table: Best scores table under the game cards on the menu (one best per game, runs with codes excluded)
features.results: Each game shows its own game-over or win screen with the score; the best-score table updates
